name: Archangel Angel Michael
overview: Scripture reveals Michael as a chief prince and protector of God's people, notably described in Daniel as standing for the children of Israel during times of great trouble (Daniel 12:1). He is depicted as a powerful angelic figure who aids in spiritual battles, coming to assist against opposing forces (Daniel 10:13, 10:21). While Psalms affirms that God commands His angels to guard His people (Psalms 91:11), Michael’s unique role as a chief prince highlights his special responsibility in God's divine order. This understanding emphasizes the reality of angelic ministry under God's sovereign authority, distinct from other angels like Gabriel who serve specific missions (Luke 1:19).
